svg.title: Material study: attach the caption to its own photograph
svg.desc: Only the first caption baseline moves from y495 to y450, closer to the bottom of its own image at y420 and farther from the second image beginning at y540. The numbered wording, all other positions, typography, photographs/crops, colors, paper and lighting remain identical. Original fictional material study; photographs are generated illustrations, not documentation of the same bowl.
